analysis: Report signed finite-difference directional response along the normalized gain path, including BF16 quantization; cross-axis response fraction and held-aside half-step residual against zero-change predictor. Record baseline and realized FP32/BF16 gains. Three controls do not identify the whole reachable subspace. No automatic candidate selection or confirmation.
